h: Zlatan reportedly buys Hermes bag for his bride ahead of weekend wedding
p: Singer Zlatan is said to have bought an expensive Hermes handbag for his fiancée before their wedding this Saturday. He also joked with fans on the street about contributing to the wedding costs.
more: Israel DMW earlier revealed what the aso ebi cost.
Guests are expected from across the entertainment scene.
